operations.name: Saw Cut Blanks
operations.setup_note: Cut individual blanks from bright round bar to allow for facing both ends. The 55 mm stock exceeds the lathe bar capacity, so blanks will be chuck-held rather than bar-fed.

operations.name: CNC Turn – Head and Axial Tapped Hole
operations.setup_note: Chuck the raw blank, face the free end, and turn the cylindrical head to establish datum A on F07. Keep the part in this setup for the axial blind tapped hole.

operations.name: CNC Turn – Taper and Threaded End
operations.setup_note: Reverse the part and grip the finished head F07 in soft jaws, picking up datum A. Face the opposite end to final length, then machine the taper, thread blank, relief groove, and external thread.

operations.name: Deburr
operations.setup_note: Deburr the machined blank and break remaining sharp edges to the drawing requirement before inspection and coating.

operations.name: Pre-Coating Dimensional and Functional Inspection
operations.setup_note: Inspect the machined part before treatment, including the specified taper contact check in the master gage.

operations.name: Clean and Mask for Phosphate
operations.setup_note: Clean and degrease the part, then mask the thread surfaces according to the confirmed PS-119.0 coverage requirements before treatment.

operations.name: Phosphate Coat
operations.setup_note: Apply phosphate coating per PS-119.0 after all machining and cleaning are complete.

operations.name: Unmask
operations.setup_note: Remove masking after the phosphate process and verify the protected areas are clear.

operations.name: Final Coating Inspection
operations.setup_note: Inspect phosphate coverage and appearance per PS-119.0 and verify the part is ready for release.

clarifications.question: What is the required radial depth of relief groove F04?
clarifications.suggested_default: Use the depth specified by the drawing or the applicable thread-relief standard; do not release the groove for machining until confirmed.

clarifications.question: What is the required depth of blind tapped hole F09?
clarifications.suggested_default: Use the drawing's intended engagement depth for the 5/8-18 UNF 2B thread; no depth is inferred from the available view.

clarifications.question: Per PS-119.0, should phosphate coat the external and internal threads, or should either thread be masked?
clarifications.suggested_default: Mask both threads and phosphate the remaining exposed surfaces, including the taper.

assumptions.text: The envelope and feature dimensions appear to be inch-derived values (for example, the 0.625-inch thread callout); they are converted to millimetres for stock sizing. The 2.125-inch maximum OD converts to 53.975 mm and the 8.05-inch envelope length to approximately 204.5 mm.
The Stress Proof free-cutting steel is treated as commercially supplied cold-drawn round bar, so bright_round_bar is selected.
The phosphate conversion coating does not require a separate cure or bake unless PS-119.0 specifies one; the generic surface-treatment cure/bake step is therefore omitted.
The turning route's part-off step is omitted because individual blanks are saw-cut to length rather than machined from bar stock and parted off.
